notes.title: "Groovy Update" comming!!
notes.notes:
There is big update named "Groovy Update" and affect game play.

[h1]New Feature [i]Groove Chance[/i][/h1]

The red colored "Groove Gauge" that indicated at bottom circle will increase when press button without notes.
[b]Groove Chance[/b] will start when the gauge filled!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/035ad11554ca566c8b5168001f6bea004f47818f.jpg[/img]

The player can beat notes in own rhythm.
But monotonous rhythm cause end of Groove Chance.

[h1]New Feature [i]Drift[/i][/h1]

Reset the junction state by [b]Drift Button[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/75a8af97a42f9cb54fe8bc72c4526a55754b1de0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Junction completion rate[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/52bf821ed80d347306290cadc39e25aaa8ccac47.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Interface adjustment
[*]All notes vanish when Deviation, and all taps treat as note tap success, and combo count increase.
[*]R Trigger stops notes while current wave only.
[*]Secret Beats will be visible when Tension is Crazy.
[*]bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Character introduction - Mayor
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/c9fb6a09ec7b951e00659571ce4015b358687311.jpg[/img]

The innovative mayor of CBC. Got the job by theoretical public commitment and performance that get a good response from citizon, for 2 years ago.
She is hostile to Disk, but her strong determination to make CBC a wonderful city is serious.
She is thick-headed, and sometimes go straight on wrong way.

She seems think the fancy dress is the most suitable clothes for anywhere.

"You looks out of breath...
Don't you go home for a cup of milk?"

notes.title: Character introduction - Rin
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/6978b7768f772fbb751b59208ae5bf7db98646cb.jpg[/img]

Disk's old friend. A police officer, ex-JJ.
She behaves mature naturally, but she is in fact her own person.
She can't leave those in trouble alone. She care about Disk.

"It's a present for you ...
I'll whip your butt !"

notes.title: Character introduction - Builder
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/ad76f0a08af95a8423d3ef237c9164919daa3d1f.jpg[/img]

A middle manager of JJ Department in CBC. Long time in CBC.
Nobody knows about his JJ skill.
He is direct supervisor of Disk and strict towards her, but in fact he is funny nice guy.
Bald head and wears suit, and dark glasses.

"Will you pile up damage not only for your watering hole but also your assessment?"

notes.title: Character introduction - Disk
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35205002/56c703f0c28ff089cd396878c28e9d546d36bca4.jpg[/img]

The main character in this game.
Transfered to Crazy Beat City (CBC) as a Junction Jockey (JJ). 23 years old, 3 years work as a JJ.
She looks young. Active and unmannerly person, and self-willed.
She always wears too big jacket, and hotpants.

"With such a sick beat, everyone gets sleepy even a runaway bank robber!"
